_what: Answer key for the gesture layer and job rewriting. NOT under src/. Roles are component roles as Rubrick labels them (kebab-case filename).

history-scrubber.why: drag-to-scrub through board history is the signature gesture; a generic board shows history as an activity list or not at all

board.why: drag-and-drop between columns is the DEFAULT gesture for a kanban board — not a delta for this kind of product, so it must not be auto-captured

leaks._what: Mechanism words that must NOT appear in the jobs handed to the twin (the history job must be stated as a need, e.g. 'review how the board changed over time').

twin._what: With the leak fixed, the twin's counterpart for history should NOT be a drag gesture.
